stories.title: Datafolha: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro empatam em 1º e 2º turnos

en.title: Datafolha: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro tied in 1st and 2nd rounds
en.summary: A Datafolha poll shows Lula with 39% voter support in the first round versus 36% for senator Flávio Bolsonaro, conducted amid institutional turbulence in Brazil's Supreme Court.

stories.title: Reajuste do Bolsa Família divide analistas sobre impacto fiscal

en.title: Bolsa Família increase divides analysts on fiscal impact
en.summary: A 15% increase to Brazil's Bolsa Família program, raising minimum payments from R$600 to R$691 per family, splits economists over its budgetary consequences, with government projecting R$5.8 billion additional cost in 2026 and R$22.7 billion in 2027.

stories.title: Lula já pediu inegibilidade de Bolsonaro por ter aumentado Bolsa Família nas eleições de 2022

en.title: Lula previously sought Bolsonaro's ineligibility for increasing Bolsa Família before 2022 elections
en.summary: Lula's team filed a request with Brazil's Electoral Superior Court in 2022 to investigate then-president Bolsonaro for expanding social benefits during that year's election campaign, seeking his ineligibility.

stories.title: Mendonça rejeita ação que questionava reajuste do Bolsa Família sem analisar legalidade da medida

en.title: Mendonça rejects action questioning Bolsa Família increase without analyzing measure's legality
en.summary: Minister André Mendonça of Brazil's Electoral Superior Court rejected a challenge filed by federal deputy Zé Tovão, allied with presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro, against the Bolsa Família increase announced by President Lula.

stories.title: Tarcísio diz que relação com Milton Leite sempre foi 'institucional' e que operação mostra que 'ninguém está acima da lei'

en.title: Tarcísio says relationship with Milton Leite was always 'institutional' and operation shows that 'no one is above the law'
en.summary: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas stated that his relationship with former city council president Milton Leite, who faces arrest warrant in Operation Vectura Corrupta investigating PCC infiltration, has always been institutional in nature.

stories.title: 'Relação institucional', diz Tarcísio sobre elo com Milton Leite, suspeito em esquema do PCC no transporte

en.title: 'Institutional relationship', says Tarcísio about his connection with Milton Leite, suspect in PCC transport scheme
en.summary: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas described his relationship with former São Paulo city council president Milton Leite, targeted by police operation and arrest warrant, as purely institutional and project-focused.

stories.title: Tarcísio diz que STF está ‘sangrando’ e comenta relação com Milton Leite: ‘Institucional’

en.title: Tarcísio says STF is 'bleeding' and comments on relationship with Milton Leite: 'Institutional'
en.summary: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas characterized his relationship with Milton Leite as institutional while also commenting on the Supreme Federal Court.

stories.title: Do Bolsa Família às bets: Lula recorre a pacote de bondades na última hora para ‘segurar’ Flávio

en.title: From Bolsa Família to bets: Lula resorts to last-minute benefits package to 'hold' Flávio
en.summary: President Lula is reportedly using various benefit programs and policy measures as a last-minute effort to maintain political support from Flávio.

stories.title: Para Lula, é melhor que falem de Bolsa Família do que de Moraes

en.title: For Lula, it's better they talk about Bolsa Família than about Moraes
en.summary: President Lula would have preferred to announce the Bolsa Família increase with better planning before this year's presidential elections.

stories.title: Mendonça rejeita ação de Zé Trovão contra reajuste do Bolsa Família

en.title: Mendonça rejects Zé Trovão's action against Bolsa Família increase
en.summary: Mendonça rejected a legal action filed by Zé Trovão against the Bolsa Família increase.

stories.title: BNDES começa a receber pedidos para empresas afetadas por tarifas dos EUA nesta quinta-feira (17)

en.title: BNDES begins receiving requests for companies affected by US tariffs on Thursday (17)
en.summary: The BNDES started accepting financing applications for the third stage of the Brasil Soberano Plan to support companies impacted by US tariffs.

stories.title: Lula inaugura uso inédito do Bolsa Família como moeda eleitoral: aumento 2 semanas antes do 1º turno

en.title: Lula inaugurates unprecedented use of Bolsa Família as electoral currency: increase 2 weeks before first round
en.summary: Lula increased Bolsa Família two weeks before the first round of the presidential elections.

stories.title: Datafolha: Lula tem 46% e Flávio, 44% no segundo turno

en.title: Datafolha: Lula has 46% and Flávio, 44% in runoff
en.summary: A Datafolha poll shows President Lula leading with 46% against Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's 44% in a runoff scenario, remaining stable from the previous week's survey.

stories.title: Campanha de Flávio vê reajuste do Bolsa Família como ‘armadilha’ e descarta judicialização

en.title: Flávio's campaign sees Bolsa Família increase as 'trap' and rules out legal challenge
en.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign views President Lula's Bolsa Família benefit increase as an electoral maneuver but has decided against pursuing legal action to challenge it.

stories.title: PF envia cópia de conteúdo de celular de Vorcaro aos ministros Luiz Fux e André Mendonça

en.title: Federal Police sends copy of Vorcaro's cell phone content to justices Luiz Fux and André Mendonça
en.summary: Brazil's Federal Police delivered a complete copy of extracted data from former banker Daniel Vorcaro's cell phone to two Supreme Court justices after they requested access following leaked messages.

stories.title: Novo programa de dívida deve prever que Tesouro compre débitos antigos de famílias

en.title: New debt program should provide for Treasury to purchase old family debts
en.summary: Brazil's government is developing a debt relief program where the National Treasury would purchase old consumer debts from creditors at steep discounts to help families improve their financial situation.

stories.title: Reajuste do Bolsa Família não prejudicará metas de resultado primário, diz Durigan

en.title: Bolsa Família adjustment will not harm primary result targets, says Durigan
en.summary: The government announced an adjustment to Bolsa Família that will be incorporated into the budget without increasing total spending or compromising primary result targets, according to the Finance Minister.
